grounding.excerpt: *5      This facility uses Ultraviolet disinfection. Total Residual Chlorine (TRC) shall be monitored any time chlorine is used within the treatment plant for
This permit shall become effective on December 1, 2021. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, November 30, 2026.

rationale: The permit text at page 5 part_i establishes that this UV-disinfection facility must monitor TRC only when chlorine is used within the treatment plant, not as routine UV-plant effluent monitoring. That directly satisfies conditional_monitoring_applies for permit NM0020583 and parameter TRC. The cover-page effective dates show the permit is in force across Federal FY2025, and the purpose A period span confirms the FY2025 window under review. Per the oracle relation contract, month-by-month whether monitoring was actually required in FY2025 remains UNRESOLVED because no chlorine-use operational log is in the packet; that is a separate operational judgment and does not undermine the structural finding that the applicable requirement is conditional rather than routine.
